diagnosis: The regression-tests failure decomposes into three mechanically independent causes, all reproduced with smaller runs: (1) tests/capture-wip.node.test.ts and tests/difficulty-capture.node.test.ts hung in 180s beforeAll hooks because they spawned 'npx vite' and regex-matched stdout for readiness that never matched; repaired by the repository's programmatic pattern (createServer from the pinned local vite, await listen(), resolvedUrls) — verified passing in ~10s each. (2) The Vitest 3.2.7 worker birpc channel answers on the worker's own event loop with a hardcoded 60s DEFAULT_TIMEOUT; any test file whose execution blocks the worker out of the poll phase for >60s fails the run with '[vitest-worker]: Timeout calling onTaskUpdate' although every test passed. Reproduced with an instrumented main-side reporter (receipt gap 2.1s -> 73.9s) and a 70s-sleep negative control. Repaired by tests/setup/worker-flush.node.ts (afterEach/afterAll macrotask flush), the headless-match generator refactor with a byte-identical sync drain plus cooperative async variant used by the three >60s synchronous test bodies, and root vitest.config maxWorkers=2 (CI defaults to one worker, serializing the battery past the check budget). (3) The scoped regression battery needs the two-worker pool to fit the check budget on this 2-vCPU host. Component: verification machinery only — tests/, vitest.config.ts, eval/runners/headless-match.ts. No assertion, coverage, command, timeout, retry or budget change; the focused reproducer is the whole regression check because the imported failure record carries no failed_test_files.
